title: Alireza Eftekhari's latest physical condition after the accident
text:
Alireza Eftekhari's latest physical condition after the accident"

"🔹Ali Azizi, Alireza Eftekhari's program manager, in an interview with a reporter from the Iranian Broadcasting Corporation: Professor Eftekhari suffered a head injury on his way back from Isfahan after being hit by a truck."

"🔹He received immediate medical treatment and is currently at home under the supervision of specialist doctors."

"🔹After an MRI and various tests, it was fortunately determined that the head injury did not lead to any internal problems in this area.
